parts.text: I am a dispatcher at one of the drone operating companies, and I plan and run the flights. I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, meaning I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves and can call it off. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and we want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
